"""API request handling."""


_INVALID_TOKEN_MESSAGE = "invalid auth token"


def _validate_auth_token(auth_token):
    """Raise ``PermissionError`` unless *auth_token* is valid.

    Keeping this check separate from request processing makes the validation
    boundary explicit and ensures untrusted data is never processed before
    authentication succeeds.
    """
    if not is_valid_token(auth_token):
        raise PermissionError(_INVALID_TOKEN_MESSAGE)


def handle_request(data, auth_token):
    """Authenticate and process an incoming API request."""
    _validate_auth_token(auth_token)
    return process(data)
